resource: Nesting depth (ChildOccurrenceRef::ancestry_depth) of a timed-revert child occurrence; its caller-supplied forward occurrence is admitted at depth at most one less
allocation_impact: Checked in ScopeRevertDriver::apply_forward on the supplied forward occurrence before the revert child is derived, and on the derived child, before any ordinal is minted, anything is committed or any record is created; a violation fails the whole forward operation with the named error OccurrenceTooDeep.
boundary_tests: max=4: a forward occurrence at depth 3 schedules a revert child at depth 4
max+1=5: a forward occurrence at depth 4 is refused OccurrenceTooDeep with no ordinal, mutation or record
consumers: apps/game-server/src/world_object_revert.rs (ScopeRevertDriver::apply_forward; not yet wired into a live Channel or Instance owner)
notes: PR #1144 round 3 (Codex P2 4125881422): ChildOccurrenceRef owns its ancestry recursively, so the record bound needs a depth bound. Registered by OTV2-20260928-cw1-timed-revert-runtime (issue #162): a lane policy value, not a measurement.
